Frequently Asked Questions

Getting Started

Email acme-researchexperts@www.example.com, and a member of our team will contact you to learn more about your background and guide you through the onboarding process.

We primarily find experts via LinkedIn and reach out to potential candidates when there may be a good fit for one of our current projects. Rest assured, we don’t share your contact information with anyone!

Our team members may reach out using one of the following email addresses:

  • @www.example.com

  • @www.example.net

  • @experts.www.example.com

A team member will spend 10–15 minutes with you to walk through our process, clarify your professional background and experience, and provide an overview of our compliance policies. This introductory call is not compensated and is intended to assess fit for the project.

We prioritize the well-being of both our clients and experts, ensuring that consultations benefit everyone involved. To achieve this, we have implemented an online onboarding process designed to prepare you for your consultations. This process helps you understand our business model and clarifies what information you can and cannot share during consultations.

Submit your availability ASAP, and complete your onboarding compliance documents at least 24 hours before the call. Want to review the topic? - Check out the Screening Questions for a short overview of what to expect. Finally, when making a call, ensure you have a strong connection and are in a quiet space for optimal audio quality.

Call Engagement Process

For compliance and confidentiality reasons, we cannot disclose client information without our client's prior consent.

Calls are 30 to 60 minute interviews conducted via audio-only dial-in. The call is recorded to ensure accurate transcription. Please note: Only discuss publicly available information. Do not share confidential or material non-public information(MNPI).

If you are not selected for a call, your profile will remain in our system, and you will be contacted if additional projects become available.

Our anonymization removes any identifiable information while still providing context to your experience for the call. For example, the transcript would read as [insert relevant role + company]. For additional role anonymization, contact your Acme Research by Globex representative for additional options. Please note that, in most cases, we are unable to anonymize your company

Call Compliance & Conduct

Yes. All Acme Research by Globex calls are recorded, transcribed, and published to the Globex platform after an embargo period. The audio is not posted publicly but may be used internally for training or to ensure transcription accuracy. Transcripts undergo rigorous compliance review before publication.

Investors and corporate teams are focused on learning about new industries and technologies, how products are used from a customer standpoint, and future potential growth opportunities for a company or industry. The information you provide should never violate a confidentiality agreement or duty of trust you may have. If you feel uncomfortable with the questions being asked on a call in this regard, please respectfully decline to answer or end the call. Our customer will understand, and we will ensure you are still compensated for your time.

Payments & Compensation

We process payments via Initech. Payment options vary based on location Payments are processed within 15 business days of your call.

Yes. Payment is prorated and rounded up to the nearest 15-minute increment. A 5-minute grace period applies: if the call goes less than 5 minutes over a 15-minute mark, it’s rounded down; if it goes 5 minutes or more over, it’s rounded up.

All payments to experts are initiated in USD. Please ensure your bank can accept wires initiated in USD.

If you received over $600 in payments from Acme Research Inc. in a calendar year, you will receive a 1099NEC to report your earnings.

Account & Platform Access

No. Access to Globex’s platform is reserved for clients who use our research product.

We have an expert portal designed to help you manage your projects, including scheduling calls and managing payments.

You can contact the last team member you worked with, or submit an update via acme-researchexperts@www.example.com. A team member will follow up.

We have designed an expert portal to create an easy way for you to manage your scheduling and payments. Any updates to profiles or expert information will need to be directed to acme-researchexperts@www.example.com.
